; rm-ayah-toolbar: load the ayah bar (QML on the tablet) into the open document's scene view.
; The bar lives in /home/root/ayah-toolbar/qml/AyahBar.qml, so it can change without a restart:
;   ayahProbe  -> JSON state of the loader and bar (read-only)
;   ayahReload -> reload AyahBar.qml from disk
;   ayahBench  -> time the bar's fixed search query mix on the tablet
; Driven from the root-only xovi FIFO: echo '>uayahReload:' > /run/xovi-mb

AFFECT /qml/device/view/documentview/DeviceSceneView.qml
    IMPORT net.asivery.XoviMessageBroker 2.0

    TRAVERSE ?#root
        LOCATE AFTER ALL
        INSERT {
            Loader {
                id: ayahBarLoader
                anchors.fill: parent
                z: 1000
                property int generation: 0
                source: "file:///home/root/ayah-toolbar/qml/AyahBar.qml?g=" + generation
                onLoaded: item.sceneView = root
            }

            XoviMessageBroker {
                id: ayahBarBroker
                listeningFor: ["ayahProbe", "ayahReload", "ayahBench"]

                function onSignalReceived(sgn, message) {
                    try {
                        if (sgn === "ayahBench")
                            return ayahBarLoader.item ? ayahBarLoader.item.bench() : "no bar";
                        if (sgn === "ayahReload") {
                            ayahBarLoader.generation += 1;
                            return "reloading " + ayahBarLoader.generation;
                        }
                        if (sgn === "ayahProbe") {
                            const b = ayahBarLoader.item;
                            return JSON.stringify({
                                status: ayahBarLoader.status,
                                active: b ? b.active : null,
                                ready: b ? b.ready : null,
                                loadError: b ? b.loadError : null,
                                results: b ? b.results.length : null,
                                selected: b ? b.selected : null,
                                span: b ? b.span : null,
                                searchMs: b ? b.lastSearchMs : null,
                                lastInsert: b ? b.lastInsert : null,
                                textMode: root.textMode
                            });
                        }
                        return "ERR unknown signal";
                    } catch (e) {
                        return "ERR " + e;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    END TRAVERSE
END AFFECT
